title: Map current account and billing journeys
description: Document how customers currently view account details, update profile information, and find invoices. Identify confusing steps and common support handoffs.

title: Interview customers and support agents
description: Gather feedback from a representative group of customers and support agents about the most common portal tasks, accessibility needs, and recurring points of friction.

title: Define portal navigation and content structure
description: Create a clear information architecture for account settings, invoices, support resources, and notifications so customers can find key actions quickly.

title: Design the accessible account overview
description: Prepare responsive designs for the account overview, including profile details, recent billing activity, and clear links to the most-used customer actions.

title: Build profile and notification settings
description: Implement the screens that let customers review their contact details and manage service notification preferences, with clear validation and confirmation states.

title: Connect the portal to invoice history
description: Integrate the invoice history view with the billing service so customers can review recent invoices and open the details for a selected billing period.

title: Create a searchable support resource center
description: Organize frequently used help articles and service guidance into a searchable section that works well on desktop and mobile.

title: Validate mobile usability and accessibility
description: Review the key customer journeys on common screen sizes and check keyboard navigation, readable contrast, and accessible labels before the portal release.
